rationales: Guessing does not systematically break a complex problem into smaller parts.
Prototyping creates a preliminary model or version of a solution.
Divide and conquer solves a complex problem by dividing it into smaller problems.
Acting it out is a way to simulate a situation, not the named divide-and-solve strategy.
Analysis is a noun and does not fit the blank as written.
Determining or identifying the problem is the first step before solving it.
“Un-understanding” is not a valid step or wording here.
Planning comes after identifying and understanding the problem.
The decimal system uses the ten digits from 0 through 9.
The decimal system does not use digits up to 16.
The decimal system is not made up of the digits 2 through 8.
The digits 0 through 7 are used in the octal system.
(10)₂ represents decimal 2, not decimal 3.
(11)₂ equals decimal 3.
(1111)₂ equals decimal 15.
(1000)₂ equals decimal 8.
A protocol is an agreed set of rules for communication between computers.
A transmission medium is the channel through which information travels.
A sender transmits information but does not define the communication agreement.
A receiver accepts information but does not define the communication agreement.
A denial-of-service (DoS) attack attempts to make a machine or network resource unavailable.
Phishing tries to deceive people into revealing information or taking harmful actions.
Hacking is a broad term for gaining access to computer systems, not specifically making services unavailable.
Piracy is the unauthorized copying or distribution of protected material.
<ol> creates an ordered list and does not specify an image URL.
<dl> creates a description list and does not specify an image URL.
The src attribute specifies the image file’s URL.
</br> is not an attribute for an image URL.
A prepared solution is not a recognized name for a solution reached without proper algorithms or planning.
A candid solution is not a recognized term for this kind of solution.
A strategied solution suggests strategy or planning and does not name an unplanned solution.
A best solution describes quality, not whether algorithms or planning were used.
In this context, the question can be answered yes or no, so it is treated as a Boolean proposition.
A categorical proposition makes an assertion about a category or class.
A moral proposition concerns moral judgment or values.
This is not the best choice because the question is treated as a yes-or-no Boolean proposition.
HTML is not a programming language in the usual sense; it describes document structure.
HTML is a markup language used to structure web content.
HTML is a markup language, not both a markup and programming language.
HTML is a markup language, so this option is incorrect.
An ordered list is a list type, not the general name for a list placed inside another list.
An unordered list is a list type, not the general name for a list placed inside another list.
A nested list is a list contained within another list item.
A definition list presents terms and descriptions; it does not name a list inside another list.
FTP stands for File Transfer Protocol.
“Fix Transfer Protocol” is not the expansion of FTP.
“File Total Protocol” is not the expansion of FTP.
“Found Transfer Protocol” is not the expansion of FTP.
“Disk object System” is not what DOS stands for.
“Disk off System” is not what DOS stands for.
This option appears to contain a spelling error; DOS stands for Denial of Service.
“Disk on Service” is not what DOS stands for.
Soft lifting is a type of software piracy involving unauthorized copying or use.
Liability is not a type of software piracy.
Client-server overuse is a recognized form of software piracy.
Online piracy is a type of software piracy.
Division has lower precedence than the logical NOT operator.
Assignment has lower precedence than the logical NOT operator.
The greater-than comparison has lower precedence than the logical NOT operator.
The ! operator is unary logical NOT and has the highest precedence among these choices.
